output_file = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False).name
voicefixer_model.restore(input_audio, output_file, mode=int(mode))
return output_file
inference.setup:
import tempfile
from voicefixer import VoiceFixer

# Initialize VoiceFixer. It handles downloading checkpoints and setting device.
# The VoiceFixer class automatically detects and uses CUDA if available.
voicefixer_model = VoiceFixer()

inputs.info: Upload an audio file to be processed by VoiceFixer.
inputs.label: Input Audio
inputs.name: input_audio

inputs.info:
Select the VoiceFixer processing mode:
0: Original Model (suggested by default)
1: Add preprocessing module (remove higher frequency)
2: Train mode (might work sometimes on seriously degraded real speech)
inputs.label: Processing Mode
inputs.name: mode

model.author: haoheliu
model.description: VoiceFixer aims to restore human speech regardless how serious its degraded. It can handle noise, reverberation, low resolution (2kHz~44.1kHz) and clipping (0.1-1.0 threshold) effect within one model.
model.name: VoiceFixer

outputs.info: The enhanced audio output from VoiceFixer.
outputs.label: Fixed Audio
outputs.name: output_audio
